# Read dataset, summarize data for each CoupleID and add nessesary information
```{r}

## Read data
data <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "raw_data", "Combined_dataset_Europe.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE))

## Convert as factor
data <- data  |> 
  dplyr::mutate(CrossType = as.factor(CrossType)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(PetriNumber = as.factor(PetriNumber)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(CoupleID = as.factor(CoupleID))

##Summarize data for each CoupleID (1053 rows)
merged_data <- data |>
  dplyr::group_by(CoupleID, CrossType, Female, Male, MaleAge, Batch, Block, Year) |>
  dplyr::summarise(sum_eggcount_corr = sum(EggCountCorr),
                   sum_larvacount = sum(LarvaeCount))

## Compute hatch rate for each CoupleID
merged_data <- merged_data |>
  dplyr::mutate(hatchrate = sum_larvacount / sum_eggcount_corr)

# Add nessesary information to the data frame
# Add column female and male infection status
## Define infected and uninfected categories
infected_categories <- c("Par6", "Bal", "Rennes", "Trento", "Am^Bal", "Am^Trento", "Am^Rennes", "Am^Par6")
uninfected_categories <- c("Am", "Mon47", "Par7", "BalT", "RennesT", "TrentoT")

## Apply the function to both females and males
merged_data <- merged_data |>
  dplyr::mutate (FemaleInfect = get_infection_status(Female, infected_categories, uninfected_categories)) |>
  dplyr::mutate (MaleInfect = get_infection_status(Male, infected_categories, uninfected_categories))

## Check the infection status of each strain is assigned
merged_data[is.na(merged_data$FemaleInfect),]

# Add column description of cross
merged_data <- merged_data |>
dplyr::mutate(Cross = as.factor(determine_cross(MaleInfect, FemaleInfect)))|>
dplyr:: mutate(Cross = factor(Cross, levels = c("Control cross 1 W- x W-", "Test cross W- x W+", "Control cross 2 W+ x W-", "Control cross 3 W+ x W+")))

# Add information about number of Couples For each CrossType
##Count the number of couples per CrossType
cross_count <- merged_data |>
  dplyr::group_by(CrossType) |>
  dplyr::summarise(Couple_count = dplyr::n())

##Create a new label combining CrossType and the number of Couples
cross_count <- cross_count %>%
  dplyr::mutate(CrossTypeLabel = paste0(CrossType, " " ,"(", Couple_count, ")" ))

## Merge the new labels with the data
merged_data <- merged_data |>
  dplyr::left_join(cross_count, by = "CrossType")

## Export file with hatch rates per Couple_ID
write.table(x = merged_data, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "Hatch_rate_CoupleID.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)


## 16 zeros out of 272 Petri dishes
## With 2–3 observations per couple, the data barely separate the random coupleID from the zero inflation (i.e. “this couple has a low mean” from “this couple had chance structural zeros”).
z <- with(merged_data, tapply(prop == 0, CoupleID,
                           function(v) paste0(sum(v), "/", length(v))))
table(z)
sum(merged_data$prop == 0)
nrow(merged_data)

```

# Check structure
## Check structure of model with zero inflation with aggregated data
```{r, eval=TRUE}
## Load aggregated data
merged_data <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "Hatch_rate_CoupleID.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE))

# Subset the data with a single type of cross (with Bal line)
dat <- merged_data[merged_data$Female%in%c("Am", "Bal")&merged_data$Male%in%c("Am", "Bal"), ]
#dat <- merged_data[merged_data$Female%in%c("Am", "Par6")&merged_data$Male%in%c("Am", "Par6"), ]

## Binomial models
msat_bin_nozi <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(cbind(sum_larvacount, sum_eggcount_corr-sum_larvacount) ~ -1+CrossType , data=dat, ziformula=~0 , family=binomial)

msat_bin_zi <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(cbind(sum_larvacount, sum_eggcount_corr-sum_larvacount) ~ -1+CrossType , data=dat, ziformula=~1 , family=binomial)

msat_bin_zi_CrossType <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(cbind(sum_larvacount, sum_eggcount_corr-sum_larvacount) ~ -1+CrossType , data=dat, ziformula=~1 +CrossType, family=binomial)

## Beta-binomial models
msat_betabin_nozi <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(cbind(sum_larvacount, sum_eggcount_corr-sum_larvacount) ~ -1+CrossType , data=dat, ziformula=~0 , family=glmmTMB::betabinomial())

msat_betabin_zi <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(cbind(sum_larvacount, sum_eggcount_corr-sum_larvacount) ~ -1+CrossType , data=dat, ziformula=~1 , family=glmmTMB::betabinomial())

msat_betabin_zi_CrossType <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(cbind(sum_larvacount, sum_eggcount_corr-sum_larvacount) ~ -1+CrossType , data=dat, ziformula=~1 +CrossType, family=glmmTMB::betabinomial())

msat_betabin_zi_CrossType2 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(cbind(sum_larvacount, sum_eggcount_corr-sum_larvacount) ~ -1+CrossType , data=dat, ziformula=~1 +CrossType, dispformula = ~ -1+ CrossType, family=glmmTMB::betabinomial())
summary(msat_betabin_zi_CrossType2)

## AICc
MuMIn::model.sel(msat_bin_nozi, msat_bin_zi, msat_bin_zi_CrossType, msat_betabin_nozi, msat_betabin_zi, msat_betabin_zi_CrossType, msat_betabin_zi_CrossType2) 

## Check convergence
m <- msat_betabin_zi_CrossType2
c(conv = m$fit$convergence, pdHess = m$sdr$pdHess)

## 0-60% of zeros comes from the zero inflation (the rest comes from the betabibomial)
plogis(glmmTMB::fixef(m)$zi)          

so <- DHARMa::simulateResiduals(m, n = 1000)
## Check that residuals are close to the diagonal
plot(so)

## No remaining zero inflation
DHARMa::testZeroInflation(so)

obs0 <- tapply(dat$sum_larvacount == 0, dat$CrossType, sum)
sim0 <- apply(so$simulatedResponse == 0, 2,
             function(z) tapply(z, dat$CrossType, sum))

cbind(observed = obs0,
       expected = round(rowMeans(sim0), 1),
       lo95     = apply(sim0, 1, quantile, 0.025),
       hi95     = apply(sim0, 1, quantile, 0.975))

## Check residuals for the homogeneity in variance
round(tapply(residuals(so), dat$CrossType, var), 3)   # more variation with Bal males
## Levene Test
DHARMa::testCategorical(so, catPred = factor(dat$CrossType))
## OK with different dispersion parameters phi for Bal vs. am males
```

## Best model estimate
```{r}
## cross type effect on hatch rate and mating probability
dat$prop <- dat$sum_larvacount / dat$sum_eggcount_corr
m <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(prop ~ -1+CrossType, ziformula=~-1 +CrossType, dispformula = ~ -1+ CrossType, family=glmmTMB::betabinomial(), weights = sum_eggcount_corr, data=dat)
summary(m)
logLik(m)
logLik(msat_betabin_zi_CrossType2)

## Compute observed hatch rate
datCrossType <- dat |>
  dplyr::group_by(CrossType) |>
  dplyr::summarise(Sum_eggcount_corr = sum(sum_eggcount_corr),
                   Sum_larvacount = sum(sum_larvacount))|>
  dplyr::mutate(hatchrate = Sum_larvacount / Sum_eggcount_corr)



## Zero-inflated part of the model
## Probability of having no mating
tapply(predict(m, type="zprob"), dat$CrossType, mean)
(p1 <- 1/(1+exp(-glmmTMB::fixef(m)$zi)))

## Predicted hatch rate
tapply(predict(m, type="conditional"), dat$CrossType, mean)
(p2 <-1/(1+exp(-glmmTMB::fixef(m)$cond)))

## Combined probability (1-prob_no_mating) x hatch rate
tapply(predict(m, type="response"), dat$CrossType, mean)
(1-p1)*p2

## Observed hatch rate
tapply(dat$sum_larvacount, dat$CrossType, sum)/tapply(dat$sum_eggcount_corr, dat$CrossType, sum)

## Extract precision parameter
tapply(predict(m, type="disp"), dat$CrossType, mean)
phi <- exp(glmmTMB::fixef(m)$disp)

## Compute overdispersion
rho <- 1 / (phi + 1)
## Check precision and overdispersion parameters
round(rbind(phi = phi, rho = rho), 3)

# Standard deviation of p (the hatch probability) among males higher among Bal males than among Am males
mu <- plogis(glmmTMB::fixef(m)$cond)
round(sqrt(mu * (1 - mu) * rho), 3)



```

# Test function fit_ZI_Beta_binomial
## Model selection for crosses with Bal 
```{r}

 ## Fit null model
  m0 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(prop~ 1, ziformula=~1 , dispformula = ~ 1, family=glmmTMB::betabinomial(), weights = sum_eggcount_corr, data=dat)
  
  ## cross type effect on hatch rate (p2)
  m1 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(prop ~ -1+CrossType, ziformula=~1 , dispformula = ~ 1, family=glmmTMB::betabinomial(), weights = sum_eggcount_corr, data=dat)
  
  ## cross type effect on mating probability (p1)
  m2 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(prop ~ 1, ziformula=~ -1 + CrossType , dispformula = ~ 1, family=glmmTMB::betabinomial(), weights = sum_eggcount_corr, data=dat)
  
  ## cross type effect on hatch rate (p2) and mating probability (p1)
  m3 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(prop ~ -1+CrossType, ziformula=~-1 +CrossType, dispformula = ~ 1, family=glmmTMB::betabinomial(), weights = sum_eggcount_corr, data=dat)
  
  ## Fit null model + differences in overdispersion among CrossTypes
  m4 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(prop~ 1, ziformula=~1 , dispformula = ~ -1+ CrossType, family=glmmTMB::betabinomial(), weights = sum_eggcount_corr, data=dat)
  
  ## cross type effect on hatch rate (p2) + differences in overdispersion among CrossTypes
  m5 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(prop ~ -1+CrossType, ziformula=~1 , dispformula = ~ -1+ CrossType, family=glmmTMB::betabinomial(), weights = sum_eggcount_corr, data=dat)
  
  ## cross type effect on mating probability (p1) + differences in overdispersion among CrossTypes
  m6 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(prop ~ 1, ziformula=~ -1 + CrossType , dispformula = ~ -1+ CrossType, family=glmmTMB::betabinomial(), weights = sum_eggcount_corr, data=dat)
  
  ## cross type effect on hatch rate (p2) and mating probability (p1) + differences in overdispersion among CrossTypes
  m7 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(prop ~ -1+CrossType, ziformula=~-1 +CrossType, dispformula = ~ -1+ CrossType, family=glmmTMB::betabinomial(), weights = sum_eggcount_corr, data=dat)
 
MuMIn::model.sel(m0, m1, m2, m3, m4, m5, m6, m7)

## Compute confidence interval for m3
## Refit model nsim times
b1 <- lme4::bootMer(m3, FUN=function(fit) extract_model(fit, estimateCI = TRUE, estimate_response=TRUE, estimate_overdisp=TRUE, newdata=dat), nsim=5, .progress="txt")
  
## Extract all CIs
confint <- data.frame(bCI_tab(b=b1))

## Add sample size
n <- tapply(dat$CrossType, dat$CrossType, length)
confint$n <- c(rep(n, times=(nrow(confint)-3)/4), rep(NA, 3))
confint <- dplyr::relocate(confint, n)
```

# Make Fig. 1
## Fit for Fig. 1 with Bal, Trento, Par6 and Rennes 
```{r}
## List of lines
europe <- unique(merged_data$Male[merged_data$Female=="Am"&merged_data$Male!="Am"])
europe <- europe[c(1, 2, 3, 11)]

## Dataframe with all the lines
crosses <- data.frame(continent=rep("Europe", 4), uninf_strain="Am" , inf_strain=c("Trento", "Bal", "Rennes", "Par6"))

## Fit all models on all the crosses function with nbootsim = 500
results <- apply(crosses, 1, fit_ZI_Beta_binomial, data=merged_data, nbootsim = 500)

## Extract the results from all models
crossnum <- 1:nrow(crosses)

confintp1 <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="confintp1"))

confintp2 <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="confintp2"))

AICC <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="modelaicc"))

overdisp <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="confintdisp"))

CI <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="confintCI"))

block <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="block"))

## Add AmxAm
names(block)[names(block)=="output.parameter...1.."] <- "block"
block <- rbind(block, c("Europe", "Am", "Control", "1", "1_2_5_6_7"))

## Export files
write.table(x = AICC, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "TableS2_model_AICc.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)
write.table(x = confintp1, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "TableS2_confintp1.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)
write.table(x = confintp2, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "TableS2_confintp2.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)
write.table(x = overdisp, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "TableS2_overdisp.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)
write.table(x = CI, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "TableS2_CI_estimates.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)


```

## Prepare observed and fitted data for Figure 1
```{r}

#Load fitted hatch rate excluding structural zeros
fitted_data <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "confintp2.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE))

## Remove duplicated AmxAm
fitted_data <- fitted_data |>
  dplyr::filter(!duplicated(CrossType))

# Add Pair
fitted_data <- fitted_data |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Pair = as.character(CrossType) |>
      sub(pattern = "^(.+)x\\1$", replacement = "\\1") |>   # XxX     -> X
      sub(pattern = "^Amx|xAm$",  replacement = "")    |>   # AmxX, XxAm -> X
      dplyr::recode(Am = "Control")                         # AmxAm   -> Control
  )|>
  dplyr::mutate(Pair = factor(Pair, levels = c("Control", "Trento", "Bal", "Par6", "Rennes")))

#Load observed hatch rate
observed_data <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "Hatch_rate_CoupleID.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE))

## Cross to used for observed hatch rate
crosses <- c("AmxAm", "BalxBal", "AmxBal", "BalxAm", "TrentoxTrento", "AmxTrento", "TrentoxAm", "RennesxAm", "AmxRennes", "RennesxRennes", "AmxPar6","Par6xPar6", "Par6xAm")

# Filter only data frot eh plot
observed_data <- observed_data |>
  dplyr::filter(CrossType %in% crosses)|>
  dplyr::mutate(Year=as.factor(Year))

## Change order for the CrosstypesLabel
desired_order2 <- c(
    "AmxAm", 
    "AmxTrento", "TrentoxAm", "TrentoxTrento",
    "AmxBal", "BalxAm","BalxBal",
    "AmxRennes", "RennesxAm", "RennesxRennes",
    "AmxPar6", "Par6xAm", "Par6xPar6")

labs <- unique(fitted_data$CrossTypeLabel)
cross_of_lab <- sub(" \\(.*$", "", labs)                 # "AmxAm (59)" -> "AmxAm"
lab_levels <- labs[order(match(cross_of_lab, desired_order2))]

fitted_data <- fitted_data |>
  dplyr::mutate(CrossTypeLabel = factor(CrossTypeLabel, levels = lab_levels))

## Add the CrossTypeLabel with the right number of replicates
observed_data <- observed_data |>
  dplyr::rename(CrossTypeLabelold=CrossTypeLabel)|>
  dplyr::left_join(fitted_data[, c("Pair","CrossTypeLabel", "CrossType")], by="CrossType")

# One row per infected strain and allowed batch
blocks <- block |>
  dplyr::mutate(Batch = strsplit(block, "_")) |>
  tidyr::unnest(Batch) |>
  dplyr::mutate(Batch = as.integer(Batch)) |>
  dplyr::select(infstrain, Batch)|>
  dplyr::mutate(Pair_block=paste(infstrain, Batch, sep="_"))|>
  dplyr::select(infstrain, Pair_block)

## 45 Petri dishes not used for the figure
observed_data |>
  dplyr::mutate(Pair_block=paste(Pair, Batch, sep="_")) |>
  dplyr::left_join(blocks, by = "Pair_block") |>
  dplyr::filter(is.na(infstrain)) 

## Remove the 45 Petri dishes not used
observed_data <- observed_data |>
  dplyr::mutate(Pair_block=paste(Pair, Batch, sep="_")) |>
  dplyr::left_join(blocks, by = "Pair_block") |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(infstrain)) 
```

## Plot new Figure 1
```{r}
#Create bar plot with individual data points
hatchrateplot1 <- fitted_data |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(aes(x = CrossTypeLabel, y = Estimate, fill = Cross), size=100) +
  ggplot2::geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  ggplot2::geom_errorbar(ggplot2::aes(ymin = X2.5., ymax = X97.5.), width = 0.4) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(data = observed_data, aes(x = CrossTypeLabel, y = hatchrate, color = Year), position = position_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0), size =3) + 
  ggplot2::geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", Estimate), y=1.1), vjust = 1.5, position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), size = 10) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Control cross 1 W- x W-" = "#00bfc4", "Test cross W- x W+" = "#F8766D", "Control cross 2 W+ x W-" = "#7cae00", "Control cross 3 W+ x W+" = "#c77cff")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c ("2023" = "#931F1D", "2024" = "#00008B")) + 
  labs(x = "Cross", y = "Hatch rate", title = "Observed hatch rate and fitted hatch rate excluding structural zeros for each cross (female strain x male strain)", fill = "Cross type") +
  ggh4x::facet_nested(~Pair, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  theme_grey(base_size = 30) +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(20, 20, 20, 20, "pt"),
        #strip.background = element_blank(),  # Removes background from facet labels
        strip.placement = "outside", 
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=30, angle = 45, hjust = 1), #modify the text of the axis x
        axis.text=element_text(size=20),
        title = element_text(size = 0), #face="bold" makes it bold
        axis.title=element_text(size=35,face="bold"),
        legend.text=element_text(size = 30),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 30),
        legend.position = "top",
        strip.text.x = element_text(size =45),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_line(linetype = "dotted", color = "grey")) + # text for the subtitles/strips
        theme(
          panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
          legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
          legend.position = "top"
          )+ylim(0, 1.1)


#save bar plot
title_plot <- "barblock1-7_Europe.pdf"
cowplot::save_plot(file = here::here("plots", title_plot),
                   hatchrateplot1, base_height = 40/cm(1),
                   base_width = 100/cm(1), dpi = 1200)
```

# Old Figure 1
```{r}

library (rlang)

#Read database
merged_data <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "Hatch_rate_CoupleID.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE))

# Filter and keep data only for screen for CI (403 rows)
data1 <- merged_data |>
  dplyr::filter(CrossType %in% c("AmxAm", "BalxBal", "AmxBal", "BalxAm", "TrentoxTrento", "AmxTrento", "TrentoxAm", "RennesxAm", "AmxRennes", "RennesxRennes", "AmxPar6","Par6xPar6", "Par6xAm"))

# Combine all CrossTypes for one Pair
data1 <- data1 |>
  dplyr::mutate(Pair = dplyr::case_when(
    CrossType %in% c("AmxAm") ~ "Control",
    CrossType %in% c("AmxTrento", "TrentoxAm", "TrentoxTrento") ~ "Trento",
    CrossType %in% c("AmxBal", "BalxAm", "BalxBal") ~ "Bal",
    CrossType %in% c("AmxRennes", "RennesxAm", "RennesxRennes") ~ "Rennes",
    CrossType %in% c("AmxPar6","Par6xAm", "Par6xPar6") ~ "Par6",TRUE ~ NA_character_ ))

data1 <- data1 |>
  dplyr::mutate(Pair = factor(Pair, levels = c("Control", "Trento", "Bal", "Par6", "Rennes")))

# Plot hatch_rate
data1 |>
  dplyr::group_by(CrossType) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = CrossTypeLabel, y = hatchrate)) +
  geom_point() +
  ggplot2::facet_grid(.~ Pair, scales = "free", space = "free", switch = "x") +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 18, size = 3, color = "red") +
  labs(x = "Crosstype", y = "Hatch rate", title = "Hatch rate by Crosstype") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

#Read data with median hatch rate estimation from the model
data_hatchrate <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "confintp2.csv"), sep=",", header = TRUE))

data_hatchrate <- data_hatchrate |>
  dplyr::rename(
    X2.5.  = `X2.50.`,
    X97.5. = `X97.50.`)

data_hatchrate <- data_hatchrate |>
dplyr::distinct(CrossType, .keep_all = TRUE)

#Fit model m1 for Par6 line to estimate hatch rate 
#Remove rows for Par6
data_hatchrate <- data_hatchrate |>
dplyr::filter(!infstrain %in% c("Par6"))

##Subset the data with a single type of cross
dat <- merged_data[merged_data$Female%in%c("Am", "Par6")&merged_data$Male%in%c("Am", "Par6"), ]

## Fit m1 model to measure hatch rate
m1 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(hatchrate ~ -1 + CrossType + (1| CoupleID), data=dat, ziformula=~ 1 , family=binomial, weight=sum_eggcount_corr)

## Check the model
glmmTMB::diagnose(fit=m1)
summary(m1)

## Hatch rate
(p2 <- 1/(1+exp(-glmmTMB::fixef(m1)$cond)))

## Refit model nsim times
  b1 <- lme4::bootMer(m1, FUN=function(fit) extract_model(fit, estimateCI = TRUE, estimate_hatche_rate=FALSE), nsim=500, .progress="txt")
  
##Confidence intervals estimation
  confint <- bCI_tab(b=b1)
  
  ##Extract data
  confintp2 <- confint[grepl("cond", rownames(confint)),]
  
  confintp2 <- as.data.frame(confintp2) |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "type")
  
  ##Change format of the data for Par6
  confintp2Par6 <- confintp2 |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    continent   = "europe",
    uninfstrain = "Am",
    infstrain   = "Par6",
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(
    continent, uninfstrain, infstrain,
    type, Estimate, `2.5 %`, `97.5 %`
  )|>
  dplyr::rename(
    X2.5.  = `2.5 %`,
    X97.5. = `97.5 %`
  )

  ##Add information about hatch rate in Par6 line to the database

dplyr::distinct(CrossType, .keep_all = TRUE)

#Fit all zero-inflated models for introgression experiment for Batch6 and Batch 7 only

 dplyr::filter(Batch == 6 | Batch == 7)

# Tetracycline experiment: Fit models with Trento, Rennes, L6, Bal lines + tetr only for Batch5

```{r}

#Filter data for Bal, L6 and Rennes only for Batch 5
merged_data_batch5 <- merged_data |>
 dplyr::filter(Batch == 5)

crosses <- data.frame(continent=rep("europe", 6), uninf_strain="Am" , inf_strain=c("Trento", "Bal", "Rennes", "TrentoT", "BalT", "RennesT"))

results <- apply(crosses, 1,
  function(x) {
    fit_ZIBinomial(
      crosses = x,
      data = merged_data_batch5,
      nbootsim = 100)})

## Extract the results from all models
crossnum <- 1:nrow(crosses)

confintp2 <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="confintp2"))

write.table(x = confintp2, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "confintp2_Tet_Batch5.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)

AICC <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="modelaicc"))

write.table(x = AICC, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "model_AICc_Tet_Batch5.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)

# Fit one zero-inflated GLMM with for BalT, TrentoT and Rennes lines

#Read database with hatch rate and CI
datat <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "confintp2_Tet_Batch5.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE))

#Remove rows for BalT, TrentoT and Rennes
datat<- datat |>
dplyr::filter(!infstrain %in% c("BalT", "TrentoT", "Rennes"))

# Fit model m1 for BalT
##Subset the data with a single type of cross
dat <- merged_data_batch5[merged_data_batch5$Female%in%c("Am", "BalT")&merged_data_batch5$Male%in%c("Am", "BalT"), ]

## Fit m1 model to measure hatch rate
m1 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(hatchrate ~ -1 + CrossType + (1| CoupleID), data=dat, ziformula=~ 1 , family=binomial, weight=sum_eggcount_corr)

## Check the model
glmmTMB::diagnose(fit=m1)
summary(m1)

## Hatch rate
(p2 <- 1/(1+exp(-glmmTMB::fixef(m1)$cond)))

## Refit model nsim times
  b1 <- lme4::bootMer(m1, FUN=function(fit) extract_model(fit, estimateCI = TRUE, estimate_hatche_rate=FALSE), nsim=100, .progress="txt")
  
  ##Confidence intervals estimation
  confint <- bCI_tab(b=b1)
  
  ##Extract data
  confintp2 <- confint[grepl("cond", rownames(confint)),]
  
  confintp2 <- as.data.frame(confintp2) |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "type")
  
  ##Change format of the data for BalT
  confintp2full <- confintp2 |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    continent   = "europe",
    uninfstrain = "Am",
    infstrain   = "BalT",
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(
    continent, uninfstrain, infstrain,
    type, Estimate, `2.5 %`, `97.5 %`
  )|>
  dplyr::rename(
    X2.5.  = `2.5 %`,
    X97.5. = `97.5 %`
  )
  
#Fit model m3 for TrentoT
##Subset the data with a single type of cross 
dat2 <- merged_data_batch5[merged_data_batch5$Female%in%c("Am", "TrentoT")&merged_data_batch5$Male%in%c("Am", "TrentoT"), ]

  #Fit model m1 for Rennes

dat3 <- merged_data_batch5[merged_data_batch5$Female%in%c("Am", "Rennes")&merged_data_batch5$Male%in%c("Am", "Rennes"), ]

```{r, eval=FALSE}

#Load the data for hatch rate per Couple (992 rows)
merged_data <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "Hatch_rate_CoupleID.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE)) |>
  dplyr::select(-CrossTypeLabel)

# Filter only necessary CrosTypes 
merged_data <- merged_data  %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(CrossType = as.factor(CrossType))%>%
  dplyr::mutate(CoupleID =as.factor(CoupleID))

dataS2 <- merged_data |>
  dplyr::filter(CrossType %in% c("AmxAm","BalTxBalT", "AmxBalT", "BalTxAm", "TrentoTxTrentoT", "AmxTrentoT", "TrentoTxAm", "RennesTxAm", "AmxRennesT", "RennesTxRennesT", "AmxTrento", "TrentoxAm", "TrentoxTrento", "BalxBal", "AmxBal", "BalxAm", "RennesxAm", "AmxRennes", "RennesxRennes")) |> ##380 rows 
dplyr::filter(Batch == 5) ##191

#Count number of Couples only for Batch 5 
##Count the number of couples per CrossType
cross_count <- dataS2 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(CrossType) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(Couple_count = dplyr::n())

##Create a new label combining CrossType and the number of Couples
cross_count <- cross_count |>
  dplyr::mutate(CrossTypeLabel = paste0(CrossType, " " ,"(", Couple_count, ")" ))

## Merge the new labels with the data
dataS2 <- dataS2 |>
  dplyr::left_join(cross_count, by = "CrossType")

# Making clones for AmxAm
## Duplicate AmxAm
Am <- duplicate_rows_by_crosstype (dataS2, "AmxAm", 1)

## Combine the original row and the cloned rows (967 rows)
dataS2 <- dplyr::bind_rows(dataS2, Am) |>
dplyr::mutate(CrossType=factor(CrossType))

## create an order 
desired_order <- c(
      "AmxAm", 
      "AmxTrento", "TrentoxAm","TrentoxTrento",
      "AmxBal", "BalxAm","BalxBal",
      "AmxRennes", "RennesxAm","RennesxRennes",
      "AmxAm_clone1",
      "AmxTrentoT", "TrentoTxAm","TrentoTxTrentoT",
      "AmxBalT", "BalTxAm","BalTxBalT",
      "AmxRennesT", "RennesTxAm","RennesTxRennesT"
   )

# Reorder the rows according to the desired order of CrossType
dataS2 <- dataS2 |>
  dplyr::mutate(CrossType = factor(CrossType, levels = desired_order)) 

# Combine all CrossTypes for one Pair
dataS2 <- dataS2 |>
  dplyr::mutate(Pair = dplyr::case_when(
    CrossType %in% c("AmxAm") ~ "Control W-",
    CrossType %in% c("AmxBal", "BalxAm", "BalxBal") ~ "Am/Bal",
    CrossType %in% c("AmxTrento", "TrentoxAm", "TrentoxTrento") ~ "Am/Trento",
    CrossType %in% c("AmxRennes", "RennesxAm", "RennesxRennes") ~ "Am/Rennes",
    CrossType %in% c("AmxAm_clone1") ~ "Control W- ",
    CrossType %in% c("AmxBalT", "BalTxAm", "BalTxBalT") ~ "Am/Balᵀ",
    CrossType %in% c("AmxTrentoT", "TrentoTxAm", "TrentoTxTrentoT") ~ "Am/Trentoᵀ",
    CrossType %in% c("AmxRennesT", "RennesTxAm", "RennesTxRennesT") ~ "Am/Rennesᵀ",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_ ))

#Create order for Pairs
pair_levels <- c("Control W-","Am/Trento", "Am/Bal", "Am/Rennes", "Control W- ","Am/Trentoᵀ", "Am/Balᵀ", "Am/Rennesᵀ")

# Convert the Pair variable to a factor with the specified order
dataS2 <- dataS2 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Pair = factor(Pair, levels = pair_levels))

# Add strain tested type to the database
dataS2 <- dataS2 %>%
  dplyr::mutate (M_strain = dplyr::case_when(
    Pair %in% c("Control W-", "Control W- ") ~ "Control W-",
    Pair %in% c("Am/Rennes", "Am/Rennesᵀ") ~ "Rennes",
    Pair %in% c("Am/Trento", "Am/Trentoᵀ") ~ "Trento",
    Pair %in% c("Am/Bal", "Am/Balᵀ") ~ "Bal",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_ )) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(M_strain = factor(M_strain, level=c("Control W-", "Trento", "Bal", "Rennes")))

#Add line type
dataS2 <- dataS2 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(LineType = dplyr::case_when(
    Pair %in% c("Control W-","Am/Bal", "Am/Trento", "Am/Rennes") ~ "Natural line",
    Pair %in% c("Control W- ","Am/Balᵀ", "Am/Trentoᵀ", "Am/Rennesᵀ") ~ "Tetracycline-treated line",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_ )) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(LineType = factor(LineType, level=c("Natural line", "Tetracycline-treated line")))

# Plot hatch_rate
dataS2 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(CrossType) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = CrossType, y = hatchrate)) +
  geom_point() +
  ggplot2::facet_grid(.~ Pair, scales = "free", space = "free", switch = "x") +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 18, size = 3, color = "red") +
  labs(x = "Crosstype", y = "Hatch rate", title = "Hatch rate by Crosstype") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

#Fit all zero-inflated models for introgression experiment for Batch6 and Batch 7 only

 dplyr::filter(Batch == 6 | Batch == 7)

results <- apply(crosses, 1,
  function(x) {
    fit_ZIBinomial(
      crosses = x,
      data = merged_data_batch67,
      nbootsim = 100)})

# Rescue and female genetic effect
##Compute hatch rate with the model

```{r}

#Read dataset
merged_data <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "Hatch_rate_CoupleID.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE))

## Dataframe with all the strains
crosses <- data.frame(continent=rep("europe", 12), uninf_strain=c("Am", "Am", "Am", "Am", "Mon47", "Par7", "Mon47", "Mon47","Par6","Trento", "Bal", "Bal") , inf_strain=c("Bal", "Trento", "Rennes", "Par6", "Bal", "Par6","Bal", "Rennes", "Bal", "Bal", "Trento", "Par6"))

## Fit all models on all the crosses function
results <- apply(crosses, 1, fit_ZIBinomial, nbootsim=500)

## Extract the results from all models
crossnum <- 1:nrow(crosses)
##crossnum <- 1:2
confintp1 <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="confintp1"))

confintp2 <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="confintp2"))

AICC <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="modelaicc"))

CI <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="confintCI"))

## Export files
write.table(x = AICC, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "model_AICc_InterStrains.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)

write.table(x = confintp1, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "confintp1_InterStrains.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)
write.table(x = confintp2, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "confintp2_InterStrains.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)
write.table(x = CI, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "CI_estimates_InterStrains.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)
```

#Load the data for hatch rate per Couple (1810 rows)

# Filter only necessary CrosTypes 
merged_data <- merged_data  %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(CrossType = as.factor(CrossType))%>%
  dplyr::mutate(CoupleID =as.factor(CoupleID))

data4 <- merged_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(CrossType %in% c("BalxPar6", "Par6xBal", "BalxTrento", "TrentoxBal" , "AmxBal", "AmxTrento", "AmxPar6")) ##142 rows

## create an order 
desired_order <- c(
  "AmxBal (46)", "AmxTrento (41)", "AmxPar6 (13)","TrentoxBal (10)", "BalxTrento (11)", "Par6xBal (10)", "BalxPar6 (11)")
      
# Reorder the rows according to the desired order of CrossType
data4 <- data4 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(CrossTypeLabel = factor(CrossTypeLabel, levels = desired_order)) 

# Combine all CrossTypes for one Pair
data4 <- data4 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Pair = dplyr::case_when(
    CrossType %in% c("AmxBal", "AmxTrento", "AmxPar6") ~ "Control",
    CrossType %in% c("BalxTrento", "TrentoxBal") ~ "Trento/Bal",
    CrossType %in% c("BalxPar6", "Par6xBal") ~ "Par6/Bal",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_ ))

#Create order for Pairs
pair_levels <- c("Control", "Trento/Bal", "Par6/Bal")

# Convert the Pair variable to a factor with the specified order
data4 <- data4 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Pair = factor(Pair, levels = pair_levels))

# Plot hatch_rate
data4 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(CrossTypeLabel) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = CrossTypeLabel, y = hatchrate)) +
  geom_point() +
  ggplot2::facet_grid(.~ Pair, scales = "free", space = "free", switch = "x") +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 18, size = 3, color = "red") +
  labs(x = "Crosstype", y = "Hatch rate", title = "Hatch rate by Crosstype") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

#Change name of L6 to Par6
change_name <- function (data, strain_name_old, strain_name_new) {
  data <- data |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      CrossType = stringr::str_replace_all(CrossType, strain_name_old, strain_name_new),
      uninfstrain = stringr::str_replace_all(uninfstrain, strain_name_old, strain_name_new),
      infstrain = stringr::str_replace_all(infstrain, strain_name_old, strain_name_new),
      type = stringr::str_replace_all(type, strain_name_old, strain_name_new),
    )}

### To do list of strains

  "L6" = "Par6",
  "L7" = "Par7",
  "MT47" = "Mon47"
  )

  new_strain <- strain_replacements[[old_strain]]
  dataS6 <- change_name(dataS6, old_strain, new_strain)
}

    "AmxRennes (29)", "Mon47xRennes (19)"
   )

# Reorder the rows according to the desired order of CrossType
median_hatch_rate <- median_hatch_rate %>%
  dplyr::mutate(CrossTypeLabel = factor(CrossTypeLabel, levels = desired_order)) 

# Plot hatch_rate
median_hatch_rate_reduced %>%
  dplyr::group_by(CrossTypeLabel) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = CrossTypeLabel, y = hatchrate)) +
  geom_point() +
  ggplot2::facet_grid(.~ Pair, scales = "free", space = "free", switch = "x") +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 18, size = 3, color = "red") +
  labs(x = "Crosstype", y = "Hatch rate", title = "Hatch rate by Crosstype") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

```

#Create full table with hatch rates
dataS3 <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "confintp2_InterStrains.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE))

dataS3 <- dataS3 |>
  dplyr::mutate(CrossType = sub(".*CrossType", "", type))

#Quick plot for the models results
ggplot(dataS3, aes(x = CrossType, y = Estimate, color = infstrain)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = X2.5., ymax = X97.5.), width = 0.1) +
  facet_wrap(~ infstrain, scales = "free_x") +
  theme_bw()

dataS3 <- dataS3 |>
dplyr::distinct(CrossType, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Add information about hatch rate to the dataset
median_hatch_rate <- dplyr::left_join(x=dataS3, y=data4[, c("CoupleID", "CrossType", "CrossTypeLabel", "hatchrate","Female", "Male", "Continent", "Pair", "Cross", "Batch", "Block", "Year")], by = "CrossType")

median_hatch_rate <- median_hatch_rate |>
  dplyr::mutate(Cross = dplyr::case_when(
      Cross == "Test cross W- x W+" ~ "CI cross W- x W+",
      Cross == "Control cross 3 W+ x W+" ~ "Rescue cross W+ x W+",
      TRUE ~ Cross
    ))

median_hatch_rate_reduced <- median_hatch_rate |>
  dplyr::distinct(CrossType, .keep_all = TRUE)

median_hatch_rate_reduced <- median_hatch_rate_reduced |>
dplyr::mutate(CrossType=factor(CrossType))

median_hatch_rate <- median_hatch_rate |>
  dplyr:: filter(!is.na(CrossTypeLabel))

# Plot hatch_rate
median_hatch_rate %>%
  dplyr::group_by(CrossTypeLabel) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = CrossTypeLabel, y = hatchrate)) +
  geom_point() +
  ggplot2::facet_grid(.~ Pair, scales = "free", space = "free", switch = "x") +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 18, size = 3, color = "red") +
  labs(x = "Crosstype", y = "Hatch rate", title = "Hatch rate by Crosstype") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# Create a Figure S3 
```{r}

hatchrateplot3 <- median_hatch_rate_reduced |> 
  ggplot2::ggplot(aes(x = CrossTypeLabel, y = Estimate, fill = Cross), size=100) +
  #ggplot2::scale_x_discrete(labels = x_label_names) +
  ggplot2::geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  ggplot2::geom_errorbar(ggplot2::aes(ymin = X2.5., ymax = X97.5.), width = 0.4) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(data = median_hatch_rate, aes(x = CrossTypeLabel, y = hatchrate), position = position_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0), size =3) + 
  ggplot2::geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", Estimate), y=1.2), vjust = 1.5, position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), size = 10) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Control cross 1 W- x W-" = "#00bfc4", "CI cross W- x W+" = "#F8766D", "Control cross 2 W+ x W-" = "#7cae00", "Rescue cross W+ x W+" = "#c77cff")) +
  labs(x = "Cross", y = "Hatch rate", title = "Median hatch rate and individual hatch rates per cross (female strain x male strain)", fill = "Cross type") +
  #ggh4x::facet_nested(~Pair, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  ggh4x::facet_nested(~Pair, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  #ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ LineType + Pair_Type, ncol = 4, scales = "free_x", strip.position = "top", drop=FALSE, labeller = label_bquote( cols = Pair_Type)) +
  ##ggplot2::facet_grid(Continent~Pair, switch = NULL, scales = "free", space = "fixed") +
  theme_grey(base_size = 30) +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(20, 20, 20, 20, "pt"),
        #strip.background = element_blank(),  # Removes background from facet labels
        strip.placement = "outside", 
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=30, angle = 45, hjust = 1), #modify the text of the axis x
        axis.text=element_text(size=20),
        title = element_text(size = 0), #face="bold" makes it bold
        axis.title=element_text(size=35,face="bold"),
        legend.text=element_text(size = 30),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 30),
        legend.position = "top",
        strip.text.x = element_text(size =45),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_line(linetype = "dotted", color = "grey")) + # text for the subtitles/strips
        theme(
          panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
          legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
          legend.position = "top"
          )

#save bar plot
